newsitem.title: UK: British "Love Bus" to hand out free condoms.
newsitem.headline: British "Love Bus" to hand out free condoms.

text.p: Female volunteers aboard a British "love bus" will tour beaches this summer, handing out free condoms to teenagers and giving advice on safe sex.
The bus, modelled on a similar anti-AIDS project in Sweden, will be staffed by young women from a charity that will also give out details of family planning clinics.

"We are concentrating on Newquay and St Ives (in southwestern England) because we believe there are a lot of unsafe sexual practices going on at this time of the year, especially around the surfing beaches," Jo Davis of Young People Cornwall told Tuesday's Daily Telegraph.
Anyone seeking sexual advice from the bus volunteers will also be able to take part in a "love lucky dip". Prizes range from compact discs to massage oil.
